films.title: Jack and the Cuckoo-Clock Heart
films.original_title: Jack et la mécanique du cœur
films.synopsis: Born on the coldest day in Edinburgh’s history with a frozen heart, Jack is saved when a midwife replaces it with a cuckoo clock. To stay alive he must never touch the hands, never lose his temper, and never fall in love — until he meets a street singer named Acacia and follows her across Europe.
films.the_mood: Whimsical gothic romance with ticking urgency: bright steampunk invention, musical melancholy, and a heart that cannot risk feeling too much.
films.notes: Added for the films-like-Coraline guide whimsical-dread group. Not previously in hosted catalog.
